title: NIKATRU entitlement contract
description: The vocabulary three runtimes have to agree about: which money world a row belongs to, and why access was taken away. Authored in contracts/entitlement/contract.js; this file grades the machine-readable copy that Dart code generation reads. A schema is what makes the JSON copy checkable by something other than a reader.

moneyEnvironments.description: The two money worlds. [5]M-12 is that they never mix; the environment comes from the Worker's configuration, never from a notification payload.

revocationReasons.description: The revocation-lifecycle reason set. Must equal the rows seeded by services/platform/migrations/0004_money_rail.sql section E.

reason.description: The stored value. snake_case, because it is written into a database column and read back by three runtimes.

restores.description: Whether this reason GIVES ACCESS BACK. Exactly one member is true today (chargeback_reversed). A copy of this set that drops the field, or flips it, locks out a customer who raised a dispute in error and lost it — and nothing else in this rail restores access to a row that was taken away.

revenuecatEventReasons.description: Which RevenueCat webhook event means which revocation reason. `reason: null` records an event that is deliberately NOT a revocation, which is a different fact from an event nobody has mapped — the client, the Worker and any extension all have to share that distinction. Every non-null reason must be a member of revocationReasons, and every runtime copy of this map must be equal: tooling/ci/assert-entitlement-contract.mjs limb 6 holds both.

event.description: The RevenueCat webhook event type, VERBATIM as the vendor spells it. A normalised copy would be a second vocabulary nobody could compare against the vendor's own reference.

reason.description: The revocation reason this event means, or null when the event is not a revocation at all. An event this table does not name revokes nothing — the conservative direction for a table whose error mode is locking out a paying customer.

why.description: The sentence that forces the answer. A mapping with no ground cannot be reviewed and cannot be re-decided when the vendor renames an event.

$comment: There is deliberately no minItems on revocationReasons beyond 1 and no enumeration of the member names here. A schema that restated the set would be a fifth copy of it, which is the failure this directory exists to remove. Equality with the SQL seed and with contract.js is a GUARD's job (tooling/ci/assert-entitlement-contract.mjs), not a schema's.
